title: JWST — latest wonders
brief: An immersive gallery of ten official James Webb Space Telescope releases from 2025–2026, hotlinked at high resolution from the ESA/Webb archive and hung in order of distance — from Neptune's first-ever photographed auroras (four light-hours away) to the re-photographed Ultra Deep Field (13+ billion years of lookback). Each plate gets a plain-language wall label: what you are actually looking at, the distance, the instrument (NIRCam/MIRI), why it matters, and one detail to zoom into — with proper NASA/ESA/CSA/STScI credits, an honest primer on reading infrared false colour, and a lightbox viewer with keyboard navigation and deep links. Every image URL and dated fact verified against esawebb.org on 3 July 2026.
da: Dark museum monograph: matte near-black walls, pure white captions, thin hairline frames, Spectral Light over Karla, no accent colour — the telescope carries every drop of colour.
